summary: This finding presents a high-risk vulnerability that requires immediate attention. The exposed S3 bucket contains sensitive customer data that could be accessed by unauthorized users. Immediate remediation is recommended to prevent data breach.

decisions.recommendation: Restrict public access to the S3 bucket immediately by applying a bucket policy that blocks all public access. Enable AWS CloudTrail logging to monitor future access attempts. Consider enabling S3 Block Public Access at the account level to prevent similar misconfigurations.
decisions.justification: The S3 bucket contains PII data classified under GDPR and CCPA regulations. Public exposure creates legal liability and reputational risk.
